turns.user_input: Load the stock data from data/stocks.csv. I want value stocks: PE ratio under 15, dividend yield above 2%, and debt-to-equity ratio under 1.5. Screen these for me.

Now rank the filtered stocks by a composite score: 40% weight on dividend yield, 30% weight on revenue growth, and 30% weight on inverse PE (lower PE = higher score). Normalize each metric to 0-1 range before weighting.
Show me the top 5 ranked stocks with all their metrics in a clear format.
Drop any stocks in the Financial sector - I'm already overweight financials in my other accounts. Show me the updated list.
Save the final stock picks to a file called final_picks.json and give me a one-line investment thesis for each pick.
